analysis: Post-hoc sink behavior association and suffix-NLL specificity
status: Secondary analysis after inspecting primary outcomes; not a new confirmatory trial

behavior.degenerate: not complete nonempty boxed OR n_tokens >= 2048
behavior.primary_test: Exact conditional within-question permutation: fix each question's sink and degeneration margins, permute degeneration labels across its 3 arms; statistic sum_q [3*n11_q - n_sink_q*n_degenerate_q]; two-sided doubled smaller inclusive tail. Independent units are questions, not response pairs.
behavior.concordance: Among sink-discordant pairs, count concordant degeneration, opposite degeneration and unchanged degeneration separately; report raw pair counts, unique contributing questions and stratified question-bootstrap 95% intervals.
behavior.pair_specific_tests: Exact two-sided sign tests among jointly discordant pairs separately for zero-hss, zero-random, hss-random; Bonferroni across these 3 tests in pooled155. Cohort subsets descriptive.
behavior.movement: For both zero-hss and zero-random count exits AND entries in each cohort and pooled; two-sided exact McNemar; descriptive paired95% intervals.
behavior.exit_recovery: Within exits, report newly boxed versus already boxed, degeneration recovery, automatic-correct changes. Do not call exit alone a behavioral improvement.

likelihood.sink_metric: m_loop is mean per-token NLL of the saved historical suffix, including saved EOS. Positive change reduces suffix likelihood. It is not automatically a repetitive loop.
likelihood.normal_metric: m_col_nll is mean per-token NLL of the full saved normal response; positive change is collateral degradation. Normal cohort is not restricted to mathematically correct responses.
likelihood.primary_rows: All sink questions with finite m_loop in every condition; all100 normal questions. Paired deltas versus NONE and paired candidate-minus-mean-matched-control effects.
likelihood.multiplicity: 98.75% intervals apply Bonferroni over 4 candidates within each explicitly named endpoint/comparison family; not a global correction over every analysis. For claims of beating all10 controls, also show candidate-minus-each-control99.875% intervals (Bonferroni over40 pairs).
likelihood.bootstrap: Same question weights across conditions; stratified independent resampling of sink and normal cohorts for between-cohort specificity contrasts.
likelihood.rank: Count strictly exceeded control point means; ranking alone is not significance. Report all10 controls and pairwise intervals.
likelihood.repeat_subset: Prespecified descriptive sensitivity using cut_rule == first_repeat only; report sample size even if zero, do not call general suffix effects loop-specific.
likelihood.collateral_claim: No equivalence margin invented. Report mean and CI; a non-significant harm estimate is not proof of no harm. Strict no-worse-than-controls claim requires upper bound of candidate-minus-control-mean NLL <= 0.
likelihood.specificity: Compute (candidate-control-mean suffix NLL change on sink) minus (candidate-control-mean full-response NLL change on normal); diagnostic given different suffix/full windows and no perturbation-energy matching for clamps.

scope: CPU-only using sealed exports; no new GPU generation, no changes to original primary decisions or labels; write all candidates including negative results
